# Playing Card Sounds

- Author: BMacZero / Brian MacIntosh
- Original page: https://opengameart.org/content/playing-card-sounds
- Original downloads: https://opengameart.org/sites/default/files/contact1.wav,
  https://opengameart.org/sites/default/files/contact2.wav,
  https://opengameart.org/sites/default/files/cut.wav
- License: Creative Commons Zero 1.0
- License URL: https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/
- Downloaded: 2026-11-12

These three source recordings are retained under their original names.
The author offers optional attribution to Brian MacIntosh.

The approved UNO sound design layers the card recordings with original procedural
plucks for reverse, skip, draw penalties and the UNO reminder. The +2/+4, reverse,
skip and reminder recipes match the approved listening montage. +1/+3 use the same
sound palette with one/three pulses.

Runtime files are in `assets/audio/uno/actions/`. Original procedural layers follow
LeoCard's project asset license. The unmodified source recordings remain CC0.

This vendor directory is excluded from the runtime asset roots.
